title: Today

title: Universal Rescue
description: One entry for every Quit program. Opens the last helpful tool; offers a person when intensity stays high; distress always routes to 988.

description: My plans hub, program catalog (the 11 programs from tetherhealthgroup.com), focus-slot rules and per-program settings.

description: Shared tabs that read every enrolment.

title: Account & data
description: Settings, programs & sharing, notifications, privacy, export, deletion with receipt, sign out.

title: System states
description: App-wide events: forced update.

title: BreatheFree
description: Tobacco & nicotine · Quit / Reduce. Four real quit paths, craving rescue, slip recovery, medication education.

title: ScrollFree
description: Social media use · Quit / Reduce. Self-report first, minute goal + app-free windows, Pause 60, buddy, weekly reflection.

title: ClearAir
description: Respiratory · Manage. Clinician action plan, zone check, yellow-zone steps with re-check, red-zone route, progress against own zones.

title: Heartwise
description: Cardiovascular · Manage. Clinician targets, two-reading BP log, validation, symptom-gated crisis route, trends, lipid panel, previewed visit summary.

title: Steady
description: Diabetes & metabolic · Manage. Clinician range + own low plan, reading log, low route with 15-min timer, meal reset, patterns, A1C.

title: Renew
description: Kidney & liver · Manage. Risk check, plain-language result, labs and trends, reminders, warning-symptom route.

title: Nourish
description: Obesity & nutrition · Build habits. Weight-neutral weekly habits, off-track reset, week-4 milestone, protective mode.

title: Stride
description: Healthy aging · Build habits. Falls check, weekly movement plan, audio-first sessions, I-fell route, home safety, scoped caregiver access.

title: Ease
description: Mental & behavioral · Support. Optional PHQ-2/GAD-2, never a diagnosis, safety plan, mood check-in, crisis route, check-back day.

title: Checkup
description: Preventive · Prevent. Personal due list from USPSTF/CDC guidance, item detail with options and cost, mark done, screening-day prep.

title: Beacon
description: Cancer · Prevent. Four journey paths: lowering risk, in treatment, after treatment, caregiver. Fever rule on the treatment path.

title: Health records (FHIR & manual)
description: Connect Epic MyChart, Oracle Health, Medicare Blue Button 2.0, Apple Health Records / Health Connect or any SMART on FHIR R4 server, or enter values by hand. Every value is validated (units, plausibility, duplicates, conflicts) and reviewed before it reaches a program.

title: ScrollFree · Unplug (proposal)
description: Optional app limits for ScrollFree: what Unplug can see, Screen Time / Android permissions, choosing apps, limits and the pause screen, focus sessions, the iPhone shield and Android overlay, the small-step gate, tracking check and turning it off. Proposal for owner review. Every pause surface reaches Rescue. Related states elsewhere: ScrollFree home (Unplug offer, Unplug on), Weekly reflection (Unplug on), Program settings (ScrollFree with Unplug), Connect Screen Time (Android, iPhone report wording).

title: Home screen, Siri & shortcuts (proposal)
description: How Tether looks outside the app: the home-screen widget, Siri and App Shortcuts on iPhone, and launcher shortcuts and the widget on Android. Labels are generic by default; program names appear only when Show sensitive details is on. These are references for the native widget and shortcut work, not app routes.
